### 将两个tif存储为为不同的file变量，126+585
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)

listfiles <- dir_info("homework3/") %>%
  filter(str_detect(path, fixed(".tif"))) %>%
  select(path) %>%
  pull()

# SSP126
file126 <- listfiles[str_detect(listfiles, fixed("ssp126_2081-2100.tif"))]

# SSP585
file585 <- listfiles[str_detect(listfiles, fixed("ssp585_2081-2100.tif"))]
```

### nylr可以反映tif中的图层数量
```{r}
## SSPS26
library(terra)
worldclimtemp126 <- terra::rast(file126)

# mount of nlyr
terra::nlyr(worldclimtemp126)
# name of nlyr
names(worldclimtemp126)
  
#have a look at the raster stack
worldclimtemp126
```
```{r}
## SSPS585
library(terra)
worldclimtemp585 <- terra::rast(file585)

# mount of nlyr
terra::nlyr(worldclimtemp585)
# name of nlyr
names(worldclimtemp585)
  
#have a look at the raster stack
worldclimtemp585
```

## 导入城市points数据并筛选UK城市
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. Import the CSV file
World_Cities <- read_csv("homework3/World_Cities.csv")

# 2. Filter UK cities and select X and Y
UK_Cities <- World_Cities %>%
  filter(FIPS_CNTRY == "UK") %>%
  select(X, Y, GMI_ADMIN, CITY_NAME)

# 3. Save as a new CSV file
write_csv(UK_Cities, "homework3/UK_Cities.csv")

# view csv
head(UK_Cities)
```

### 关键：转化坐标系，将投影坐标系转化为地理坐标系
```{r}
# 读取 CSV
cities <- read.csv("homework3/UK_Cities.csv")

# 将 X、Y 创建为空间点，指定原始 CRS 为 EPSG:3857
cities_sf <- st_as_sf(
  cities,
  coords = c("X", "Y"),
  crs = 3857,
  remove = FALSE
)

# 转换为 WGS 84
cities_wgs84 <- st_transform(cities_sf, 4326)

# 提取经纬度
coords <- st_coordinates(cities_wgs84)

# 添加经纬度列
cities$Longitude <- coords[, 1]
cities$Latitude <- coords[, 2]

# 保存转换后的 CSV
write.csv(cities, "homework3/UK_Cities_WGS84.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 读取新的文件
UK_Cities_WGS84 <- read.csv("homework3/UK_Cities_WGS84.csv")

# 删除原本的投影坐标系
UK_Cities_WGS84 <- UK_Cities_WGS84 %>%
  select(Longitude, Latitude, CITY_NAME)

write.csv(
  UK_Cities_WGS84,
  "UK_Cities_WGS84.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

add the points
terra::extract() 默认将前两列作为坐标，因此需要确保 X /Lon在第一列（经度），Y /Lat在第二列（纬度）
```{r}
## Extract rain data for all UK cities
UK_Cities <- read_csv("homework3/UK_Cities_WGS84.csv")

samples <- data.frame(
  lon = UK_Cities$Longitude,
  lat = UK_Cities$Latitude
)

## 保留城市名，并使用 as_tibble() 将提取结果转换为 tibble
# SSP126
UKcityramp01 <- terra::extract(worldclimtemp126, samples) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  add_column(site = UK_Cities_WGS84$CITY_NAME, .before = "Jan")

# SSP585
UKcityramp02 <- terra::extract(worldclimtemp585, samples) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  add_column(site = UK_Cities_WGS84$CITY_NAME, .before = "Jan")
```

## 已有数据测试
```{r}
Londonramp <- UKcityramp01 %>%
  filter(site=="London")
```


### tif数据分析的关键：我们需要将光栅变成数据帧（或tibble）

```{r}
exactGBR<-terra::mask(GBRramp, GBRoutline)
```

```{r}
#subset using the known location of the raster
hist(exactGBR[[3]], col="red", main ="March rain")
```

```{r}
exactGBRdf <- exactGBR %>%
  as.data.frame()
```
